name: Front Maxer
description: Designs, builds and reviews interfaces by combining UI/UX research, art direction and an ergonomics review.
why: Three design skills behind one entry point: **UI UX Pro Max** for structure and tokens, **Taste** for art direction on public pages, **Apple Design** for usability. The agent keeps **one coherent direction** and your project's choices. Works on top of those three skills, installed next to it.
yes: Improving a dashboard without losing its density
Reviewing the usability of mobile or desktop screens
no: Back-end or data work with no interface
Without the three design skills installed alongside

examples.title: A landing page
examples.input:
Use `$front-maxer` to create a
landing page for my photo studio.
examples.output: The agent sets a direction (layout, type, palette), builds the page, then checks it at small and large sizes, with the keyboard and with reduced motion.

examples.title: A local fix
examples.input:
Fix the responsive layout of this card
with `$front-maxer`, without redoing the page.
examples.output: A targeted fix that keeps the surrounding direction: no new palette, no extra animation.
